source.description: Two synthetic CN_A and US_EQUITY sessions per market to prove missed-window re-evaluation before FakeBroker execution.
source.license: Internal synthetic simulation schedule; not a complete exchange calendar.

semantics.timezone: Per-session IANA timezone; open and close values are local wall-clock Fixture instants.
semantics.prices: No prices or market data; the existing AUTO order input remains a separate fixed Fixture.

sessions.calendar: Two explicitly listed synthetic sessions per market; the first AUTO window is missed and the second is re-evaluated.

qualityCases: exactly two ordered sessions per market with distinct local timezones
each session close resolves strictly after its open
no order is created for a missed first session
AUTO execution occurs in the next session after a fresh Proposal and Mandate
day-end reconciliation reads actual Portfolio and independent FakeBroker facts

expectedAssertions.description: The first session is marked MISSED_WINDOW with no stale order; the next session re-evaluates through a new Proposal and Mandate, executes one order per market, then reconciles at close.
